3100.commentary: (PVa) dāne adhikato ahun'ti deyyadhammassa pariccajane dān'ādhikāre adhikato ṭhapito ahosiṃ.

examples.text: aṅgīrasassa gahapatino, saddhassa gharam'esino, tass'āhaṃ dānavissagge, dāne adhikato ahuṃ.

3103.meaning1: extra month in the lunar calendar; leap month

3104.commentary: (VIN 1.2.8) adhikaraṇaṃ nāma cattāri adhikaraṇāni, vivād'ādhikaranaṃ, anuvād'ādhikaraṇaṃ, āpatt'ādhikaraṇaṃ, kicc'ādhikaraṇaṃ.

examples.text: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā amūlakañ'c'eva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅgh'ādiseso.
sace mayaṃ imāhi āpattīhi aññam'aññaṃ kāressāma, siyā'pi taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ kakkhaḷattāya vāḷattāya bhedāya saṃvatteyya.
324, 339. dvipade tulya-adhikaraṇe kammadhārayo.
tesaṃ mahantasaddānaṃ mahāādeso hoti tulya-adhikaraṇe pade.

3106.synonym: āyatana, ārammaṇa, kāraṇa, ṭhāna, nidāna, nibandhana, nimitta
3106.commentary: (SNa) khettaṃ taṃ na hotī'ti-ādīsu'pi viruhan'aṭṭhena taṃ khettaṃ na hoti, patiṭṭhān'aṭṭhena vatthu na hoti, paccay'aṭṭhena āyatanaṃ na hoti, kāraṇ'aṭṭhena adhikaraṇaṃ na hoti.

examples.text: āyatanaṃ taṃ na hoti yaṃpaccay'āssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. adhikaraṇaṃ taṃ na hoti yaṃpaccay'āssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhan'ti.

3107.meaning1: detail; technicality; point of dispute; hot question
3107.commentary: (MNa) na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesī'ti mañ'ca dhammakāraṇā na kilamesi, na punappunaṃ kathāpesī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (UDa) na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇan'ti dhammadesanāhetu na ca maṃ vihesesi yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipannattā. yo hi satthu santike dhammaṃ sutvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ vā gahetvā yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ na paṭipajjati, so satthāraṃ viheseti nāma.

examples.text: paṇḍito, bhikkhave, pukkusāti kulaputto paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamma-adhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi.

3110.meaning2: (gram) locative case in the sense of containing

3112.meaning1: who lays charges; who creates legal issues; who starts lawsuits
3112.commentary: (ANa) adhikaraṇakārako'ti catunnaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ aññatarassa kārako. (NIDD1a) vivādakārakā'ti nānāvacanaṃ karontā. adhikaraṇakārakā'ti vinicchayapāpuṇanavisesakāraṇaṃ karontā.

examples.text: tassa parikkhāraṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, bhaṇḍanakārakaṃ kalahakārakaṃ vivādakārakaṃ bhassakārakaṃ saṅghe adhikaraṇakārakaṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, tassa parikkhāraṃ nikkaḍḍhati vā nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā
yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako, tassa ime pañca ādīnavā pāṭikaṅkhā'ti.

3113.meaning2: who causes disputes; who makes lawsuits

3114.meaning1: rule about being angry over a legal issue

3115.meaning1: engaged in legal dispute; arguing about a vinaya issue

examples.text: bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivād'āpannānan'ti adhikaraṇajātānaṃ.

3116.meaning1: (vinaya) belonging to another class of legal issues

examples.text: aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassā'ti āpatt'aññabhāgiyaṃ vā hoti adhikaraṇ'aññabhāgiyaṃ vā.

3117.meaning1: in the sense of a support

3118.meaning1: related to settling of a legal issue
3118.commentary: (VINa) catubbidhaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ samen'ti vūpasamentī'ti adhikaraṇasamathā. tesaṃ vitthāro khandhake ca parivāre ca vutto, tass'atthaṃ tatth'eva vaṇṇayissāma.

examples.text: ime kho pan'āyasmanto satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā. tatth'āyasmante, pucchāmi kacci'ttha parisuddhā, dutiyam'pi pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā, tatiyam'pi pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā

3119.meaning1: way of settling of a dispute; method of resolving a legal issue

examples.text: satta kho pan'ime, ānanda, adhikaraṇasamathā, uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako.

3123.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of adhikaraṇa
3123.meaning1: for the sake of; for the purpose of; with regard to
3123.meaning2: in consequence of, for the sake of

examples.text: so tesaṃ bhogānaṃ ārakkhā-adhikaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, kin'ti me bhoge n'eva rājāno hareyyuṃ, na corā hareyyuṃ, na aggi daheyya, na udakaṃ vaheyya, na appiyā dāy'ādā hareyyun'ti
yato-adhikaraṇam'enaṃ cakkhu'ndriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjāhi.

3124.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of adhikaraṇa
3124.meaning1: due to; because of; on account of
3124.commentary: (VISMa) rūp'ādhikaraṇan'ti rūpahetu. hetuattho hi ettha adhikaraṇasaddo kām'ādhikaraṇan'ti-ādīsu (ma. ni. 1.168-169) viya.

examples.text: dissanti kho pana rūpa-adhikaraṇaṃ daṇḍ'ādāna-satth'ādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvaṃtuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādā.

3127.meaning1: extra duty; additional obligation; further business

examples.text: api ca, bhante, mayam'p'etaṃ jānāma, n'etaṃ bhagavato kappatī'ti. idaṃ me, bhante, candanaphalakaṃ agghati adhikasatasahassaṃ, taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti. paṭiggahesi bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.

3130.meaning1: (gram) governing rule which affects those that follow

examples.text: adhikāre maṅgale c'eva, nipphanne c'āvadhāraṇe, anantare c'apādāne, athasaddo pavattati.
kāle'icc'etaṃ adhikār'atthaṃ veditabbaṃ.

3136.meaning1: (gram) fact of being under the governing rule which affects those that follow

3137.meaning1: (gram) governing rule (which affects those that follow); for the purpose of the following

examples.text: kāle'icc'etaṃ adhikār'atthaṃ veditabbaṃ.

3138.meaning1: regarding; concerning; with reference (to); on account (of)

examples.text: jīvassa yattako paricchedo yāvajīvaṃ, cittam'adhikicca pavattanti te dhammā'ti adhicittaṃ, pabbatassa tiro tiropabbataṃ, sotassa pati pavattati nāvā iti patisotaṃ, pāsādassa anto antopāsādaṃ.

3139.meaning1: cutting up; chopping up; grinding up; pulverizing
3139.commentary: (NIDD1a) asi ca sūnā ca upamā etesan'ti asisūn'ūpamā. adhikuṭṭan'aṭṭhenā'ti chindan'aṭṭhena.

examples.text: asisūn'ūpamā kāmā adhikuṭṭan'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti
sattisūl'ūpamā kāmā, khandh'āsaṃ adhikuṭṭanā, yaṃ tvaṃ kāmaratiṃ brūsi, aratī dāni sā mama.

3141.meaning1: concerning girls; with reference to a young woman

examples.text: kumārīsu adhikicca pavattati kathā iti adhikumāri, vadhuyā samīpe pavattati kathā iti upavadhu, gaṅgāya samīpe pavattati kathā iti upagaṅgaṃ, maṇikāya samīpe pavattati kathā iti upamaṇikaṃ.
napuṃsake vattamānassa abyayībhāvasamāsassa liṅgassa saro rasso hoti. kumārīsu adhikicca pavattati kathā iti adhikumāri. upavadhu, upagaṅgaṃ, upamaṇikaṃ.

3142.meaning1: very wholesome; highly beneficial; extremely profitable
3142.commentary: (DNa) adhikusalesū'ti ettha atthi kusalā, atthi adhikusalā. sabbe'pi kām'āvacarā kusalā kusalā nāma, rūp'āvacarā adhikusalā. ubho'pi te kusalā nāma, arūp'āvacarā adhikusalā. sabbe'pi te kusalā nāma, sāvakapāramīpaṭilābhapaccayā kusalā adhikusalā nāma. te'pi kusalā nāma, paccekabodhipaṭilābhapaccayā kusalā adhikusalā. te'pi kusalā nāma, sabbaññutaññāṇappaṭilābhapaccayā pana kusalā idha adhikusalā'ti adhippetā. tesu adhikusalesu dhammesu daḷhasamādāno ahosi avatthitasamādāno.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu, avatthitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposath'upavāse matteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitāya aññatar'aññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu.

3145.synonym: ādeti, upeti, paṭilabhati, pappoti, labhati, vindati

examples.text: sārañ'ca sārato ñatvā, asārañ'ca asārato, te sāraṃ adhigacchanti, sammāsaṅkappagocarā.
so, bhogā me atthi uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā'ti adhigacchati sukhaṃ, adhigacchati somanassaṃ.

3146.synonym: ajjhagami, alattha, alābhesi, paccalattha, paṭilabhi, labhi

examples.text: araṇisahitaṃ dvidhā phālesi, tidhā phālesi, catudhā phālesi, pañcadhā phālesi, dasadhā phālesi, satadhā phālesi, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ akāsi, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā udukkhale koṭṭesi, udukkhale koṭṭetvā mahāvāte opuni, app'eva nāma aggiṃ adhigaccheyyan'ti. n'eva so aggiṃ adhigacchi.

3147.meaning1: reached; attained; entered into a state; reached a condition
3147.commentary: (THIa) evaṃbhūtā'pi hutvā adhicca laddhāya kalyāṇamittasevāya amatam'adhigacchi, nibbānaṃ anuppattā.

examples.text: vasitā susānamajjhe, atho'pi khāditāni puttamaṃsāni, hatakulikā sabbagarahitā, matapatikā amatam'adhigacchiṃ.
evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso jighacchādubbalyapareto madhupiṇḍikaṃ adhigaccheyya, so yato yato sāyeyya, labheth'eva sādurasaṃ asecanakaṃ

so tattha aññe deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti dibbena āyunā dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena dibbena yasena dibbena ādhipateyyena dibbehi rūpehi dibbehi saddehi dibbehi gandhehi dibbehi rasehi dibbehi phoṭṭhabbehi.

siyā, sumaneti bhagavā avoca, yo so, sumane, dāyako so amuṃ adāyakaṃ manussabhūto samāno pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti, mānusakena āyunā, mānusakena vaṇṇena, mānusakena sukhena, mānusakena yasena, mānusakena ādhipateyyena.
atthi nu kho me uttari manussadhammo alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-viseso adhigato, yen'āhaṃ pacchime kāle sabrahmacārīhi puṭṭho na maṅku bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakk'āvasissati. so hoti samādhi na c'eva santo na ca paṇīto nappaṭippassaddhaladdho na ekodibhāva-adhigato sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato hoti.

3153.meaning1: held (in relation to); possessed (with regard to); found (in)
3153.commentary: (SNa) asmī'ti adhigatan'ti asmī'ti evaṃ pavattā taṇhāmānā adhigatā.

examples.text: imesu khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmi, na c'amhi arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo, api ca me, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu asmī'ti adhigataṃ, ayam'aham'asmī'ti na ca samanupassāmī'ti.

3156.meaning1: perceiving as attained; thinking one has achieved (something)
3156.commentary: (VINa) adiṭṭhe diṭṭhasaññino'ti arahatte ñāṇacakkhunā adiṭṭhey'eva, diṭṭhaṃ amhehi arahattan'ti diṭṭhasaññino hutvā. esa nayo appatt'ādīsu.

3157.meaning1: can be obtained; can be experienced (by)

examples.text: na kho, āvuso gotama, sukhena sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, dukkhena kho sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ.

3158.meaning1: to get; to attain; to acquire; to obtain

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, na kho taṃ sukaraṃ sukhaṃ adhigantuṃ evaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyena, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ odanakummāsan'ti.

3159.meaning1: having got; having attained; having acquired; having achieved

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, idha samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigaccheyya, kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantvā na parassa āroceyya, kiñ'hi paro parassa karissati.

3160.commentary: (DNa) paṭhamo okās'ādhigamo'ti paṭhamajjhānaṃ pañcanīvaraṇāni vikkhambhetvā attano okāsaṃ gahetvā tiṭṭhati, tasmā paṭhamo okās'ādhigamo'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: ayaṃ kho, bho, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena paṭhamo okāsa-adhigamo anubuddho sukhassa-adhigamāya.

3161.meaning2: approach to scripture; scribing of scripture

3166.meaningLit: for the purpose of reaching; for the sake of attaining

examples.text: cattār'imāni, gahapati, sukhāni adhigamanīyāni gihinā kāmabhoginā kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ upādāya. katamāni cattāri? atthisukhaṃ, bhogasukhaṃ, ānaṇyasukhaṃ, anavajjasukhaṃ.

3169.grammar: fut of adhigacchati or adhigameti, trans (+acc)
3169.meaning1: will attain; will achieve; will acquire

examples.text: tena kho pana maṃ, aggivessana, samayena pañca bhikkhū paccupaṭṭhitā honti, yaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ adhigamissati, taṃ no ārocessatī'ti.

tāya'pi kho tvaṃ, āvuso gotama, iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya n'ājjhagamā uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ, kiṃ pana tvaṃ eta'r'ahi bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesan'ti?
tena kho pana maṃ, rājakumāra, samayena pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū paccupaṭṭhitā honti, yaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ adhigamissati taṃ no ārocessatī'ti.

3171.meaning1: could get; would find; should attain
3171.meaning2: could get; would find; should attain

examples.text: kadā iṇ'aṭṭo'va daliddako nidhiṃ, ārādhayitvā dhanikehi pīḷito, tuṭṭho bhavissaṃ adhigamma sāsanaṃ, mah'esino taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

3174.meaning1: fact of having taken hold of; fact of having been acquired; fact of being possessed

examples.text: appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti, puññakiriyāsu paṇḍitā, appamatto ubho atthe, adhiggaṇhāti paṇḍito.

3176.commentary: (DNa) adhiggaṇhātī'ti adhibhavati, aññehi devehi atirekaṃ labhatī'ti attho.

examples.text: amamā, apariggahā, niyat'āyukā, visesaguṇā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi ṭhānehi uttarakurukā manussā deve ca tāvatiṃse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse.

3177.commentary: (ANa) adhiggahitā'ti sabb'ete tuṭṭhacittassa bhikkhuno adhiggahitā honti antogatā na paribāhirā'ti. (ITIa) adhiggahitā'ti sabbe te tuṭṭhacittassa santuṭṭhacittena bhikkhunā adhiggahitā paṭipakkhadhamme abhibhavitvā gahitā honti abbhantaragatā, na bāhiragatā'ti.

examples.text: ye c'assa dhammā akkhātā, sāmaññass'ānulomikā, adhiggahitā tuṭṭhassa, appamattassa sikkhato'ti.

3178.meaning1: what one has practised; what one has rehearsed; what one has prepared
3178.commentary: (SNa) adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattan'ti yaṃ tuyhaṃ dīghena kālena paricitaṃ suppaguṇaṃ, taṃ mama vādaṃ āgamma sabbaṃ khaṇena viparāvattaṃ nivattaṃ.

examples.text: micchāpaṭipanno tvam'asi, aham'asmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahito'si, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī'ti.
anūpavādo anūpaghāto, pātimokkhe ca saṃvaro, mattaññutā ca bhattasmiṃ, pantañ'ca sayan'āsanaṃ, adhicitte ca āyogo, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
adhicittam'anuyuttena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā pañca nimittāni kālena kālaṃ manasi kātabbāni. katamāni pañca?

3180.meaning1: engaged in meditation; devoted to mental development; cultivating the higher mind
3180.commentary: (MNa) adhicittamanuyuttenā'ti dasakusalakammapathavasena uppannaṃ cittaṃ cittam'eva, vipassanā-pādaka-aṭṭha-samāpatti-cittaṃ tato cittato adhikaṃ cittan'ti adhicittaṃ. anuyuttenā'ti taṃ adhicittaṃ anuyuttena, tattha yuttappayuttenā'ti attho.

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno oḷārikā upakkilesā kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ
adhicittam'anuyuttena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā pañca nimittāni kālena kālaṃ manasi kātabbāni. katamāni pañca?

3181.meaning1: meditation training; development of the higher mind; (comm) suttapiṭaka
3181.commentary: (VINa) tathā hi, vinayapiṭake visesena adhisīlasikkhā vuttā, sutt'antapiṭake adhicittasikkhā, abhidhammapiṭake adhipaññāsikkhā.

examples.text: tisso imā, bhikkhave, sikkhā. katamā tisso? adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā.
sikkhā'ti tisso sikkhā, adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā. tatra y'āyaṃ adhisīlasikkhā, ayaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetā sikkhā'ti.

3182.meaning1: undertaking the training in higher mind; engaging in meditation

examples.text: adhisīlasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhicittasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhipaññāsikkhāsamādānaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi samaṇassa samaṇiyāni samaṇakaraṇīyāni.

3183.meaning2: as regards thought, as to meditation

3184.meaning2: in regards to thought, to meditation

3187.meaning1: unlikely; by chance; without cause or reason; exceptional

examples.text: adhiccam'idaṃ, bhante, yaṃ so kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjanto amusmiṃ ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvaṃ paveseyyā'ti.

evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.

3189.meaning1: it is by chance; it is by accident

examples.text: adhiccam'idaṃ, bhante, yaṃ so kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjanto amusmiṃ ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvaṃ paveseyyā'ti.

evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.

3190.meaning1: occurring by chance; spontaneously arisen; accidental; fortuitous

examples.text: santi pan'āvuso sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti.
kiṃ nu kho, āvuso sāriputta, sayaṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ, paraṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ, sayaṃkatañ'ca paraṃkatañ'ca jarāmaraṇaṃ, udāhu asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ jarāmaraṇan'ti?

ayaṃ ubhay'attha dosaṃ disvā ubhayaṃ paṭikkhipati. atha kathaṃ uppanno'ti āha, adhiccasamuppanno'ti yadicchāya samuppanno kenaci kāraṇena vinā uppanno'ti adhiccasamuppannavādo dassito. tena ca ahetukavādo'pi saṅgahito hoti.

3192.meaning1: believing in fortuitous origination; believing in causeless manifestation
3192.meaning2: who believes in fortuitous origination; who believes in causeless manifestation
3192.commentary: (DNa) adhiccasamuppanno attā ca loko cā'ti dassanaṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ. taṃ etesaṃ atthī'ti adhiccasamuppannikā. adhiccasamuppannan'ti akāraṇasamuppannaṃ.

examples.text: te ca bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kim'āgamma kim'ārabbha adhiccasamuppannikā adhiccasamuppannaṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti dvīhi vatthūhi?

3193.meaning2: rarely making transgression; by chance guilty of an offence; occasionally offending
3193.commentary: (VINa) adhicc'āpattiko nāma yo kadāci karahaci āpattiṃ āpajjati.

examples.text: idha, bhaddāli, ekacco bhikkhu adhicc'āpattiko hoti anāpattibahulo.

3194.meaning1: regarding what is repulsive; concerning what is abhorrent; (comm) highest disgust
3194.meaning2: as regards what is detestable, as regards scrupulousness
3194.commentary: (DNa) adhijegucchan'ti idha jigucchabhāvo jegucchaṃ, uttamaṃ jegucchaṃ adhijegucchaṃ, tasmā yadidaṃ adhijegucchaṃ, tattha aham'eva bhiyyo'ti evam'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: yāvatā, kassapa, ariyā paramā tapojigucchā, n'āhaṃ tattha attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi, kuto bhiyyo! atha kho aham'eva tattha bhiyyo, yadidaṃ adhijegucchaṃ.

3195.meaning1: regarding what is repulsive; concerning what is abhorrent
3195.meaning2: as regards what is detestable, as regards scrupulousness
3195.commentary: (DNa) adhijegucche'ti vīriyena pāpajigucchan'ādhikāre pañhaṃ pucchi. (DNa) adhijegucche'ti vīriyena pāpajigucchanabhāve.

examples.text: tatra maṃ aññataro tapabrahmacārī nigrodho nāma adhijegucche pañhaṃ apucchi. tass'āhaṃ adhijegucche pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākāsiṃ. byākate ca pana me attamano ahosi paraṃ viya mattāyā'ti.
tato ce uttari appaharite'pi ṭhito adhiṭṭhaheyya, pācittiyaṃ.

3197.meaning2: stands firmly; determines; resolves; fixes attention on

examples.text: ālokasaññaṃ manasi kareyyāsi, divāsaññaṃ adhiṭṭhaheyyāsi, yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā. iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveyyāsi

3198.meaning1: concentrating; focusing; fixing one's attention; resolving (on)
3198.commentary: (ANa) vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhahā'ti vīriyasampayuttaṃ samathaṃ adhiṭṭhaha, vīriyaṃ samathena yojehī'ti attho.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, soṇa, vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhahaṃ, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjha, tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto sikkheyya, saddhāya adhimuccanto sikkheyya, vīriyaṃ paggaṇhanto sikkheyya, satiṃ upaṭṭhapento sikkheyya
ṭhitena kāyena ṭhitena cetasā, tiṭṭhaṃ nisinno uda vā sayāno, etaṃ satiṃ bhikkhu adhiṭṭhahāno, labhetha pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, laddhāna pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche'ti.
